needs.what: a card-level cost_reduction head that reduces the generic cost by the amount of life its caster gained this turn (the turn-ledger value life_gained_this_turn, read at pricing time like energy_spent_this_turn)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cost_reduction_keys offer amount (a flat int only), count, distinct_mana_values, energy_spent_this_turn, greatest_count, greatest_mana_value, total_mana_value and total_power; life_gained_this_turn exists as an effect value but reduction_amount has no head that reads it, and a condition-gated flat amount gives a fixed discount rather than X

needs.what: a triggered ability that functions while the card is in its owner's graveyard (beginning of your end step, intervening-if you gained life this turn) and on resolution lets its controller cast that card from the graveyard right then, ignoring sorcery timing, paying its cost
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Oathsworn Vampire's static graveyard_cast permission is a standing permission at normal timing, not a one-shot cast during the end-step trigger's resolution; cast_card/grant_playable act on selected objects from a battlefield source and no trigger key makes the end_step trigger function from the graveyard
